subject: Expansion QBR + roadmap demo — availability straw poll
messages:
From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
To: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@wellspringtx.com>, Tom Becker <tom.becker@wellspringtx.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Expansion QBR + roadmap demo — availability straw poll

Hi Sarah / Tom —

Thanks again for the time yesterday. As we discussed, Redwood would like to run a 60–75 minute Renewal/Expansion QBR that includes:
- 25–30 min roadmap walkthrough (new infra improvements + lower-latency serving options)
- 20–25 min hands-on demo (tenant migration patterns and cost profiles)
- 10–15 min procurement/next-steps (pricing, milestones, SOW/MOU)

To make scheduling painless, can you pick the best slots from this quick straw poll? I can lock whichever one works for your execs: 
1) Tue 25 May, 10:00–11:15 AM PT
2) Wed 26 May, 2:00–3:15 PM PT
3) Thu 27 May, 8:30–9:45 AM PT

If none of the above work, tell us two windows that do and we’ll adapt. Attached is a draft agenda for reference (Agenda_v1.pdf).

Key asks from our side: please confirm 1) who from Wellspring will attend the procurement portion (legal/procurement contact), and 2) whether you need a dedicated network runbook call in advance.

Thanks — looking forward to locking this in.

Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive | Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0192
Attachment: Agenda_v1.pdf (pdf, 45KB)
From: Sarah Lim <sarah.lim@wellspringtx.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Becker <tom.becker@wellspringtx.com>, Monica Patel <monica.patel@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi.malhotra@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 11:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Expansion QBR + roadmap demo — availability straw poll

Ben —

Thanks, the agenda looks good. Quick answers:
- Procurement: I will loop in our procurement lead, Lila Chen, once we lock a time. She is available most afternoons.
- Network runbook: yes please — Tom will coordinate the pre-call with your ops team.

From the slots you proposed, our availability is:
- Option 1 (Tue 25 May, 10:00–11:15 AM PT): conflict — execs in a planning offsite
- Option 2 (Wed 26 May, 2:00–3:15 PM PT): appears to work for Sarah/Tom; Lila would need an afternoon time
- Option 3 (Thu 27 May, 8:30–9:45 AM PT): too early for our East Coast execs

Can we tentatively lock Option 2 (Wed 26 May, 2:00–3:15 PM PT)? If Lila confirms, we’ll finalize. If she can’t do 2pm, proposed fallback windows: Wed 26 May 3:30–4:45 PM PT or Fri 28 May 11:00–12:15 PM PT.

Also CC’ing Tom’s assistant (t.becker.assistant@wellspringtx.com) in the next thread for calendar holds.

Best,
Sarah
Head of Data Platform | Wellspring Therapeutics

Thanks for the quick reply, Sarah —

If we lock Wed 26 May at 2pm PT I’ll plan the run-of-show and bring a short tech pre-brief (30 mins) the week prior for your engineers. Suggested run-of-show (high level):
- 2:00–2:05 PM PT: Introductions + objectives (Ben)
- 2:05–2:35 PM PT: Product roadmap + infra improvements (Rishi)
- 2:35–2:55 PM PT: Live demo (monica.patel + eng)
- 2:55–3:10 PM PT: Procurement/next steps (Ben + Sarah)
- 3:10–3:15 PM PT: Wrap / action items

Action items for Wellspring: please confirm the procurement contact (Lila) and whether anyone from network/security will join the pre-brief.

I’m happy to run the tech pre-brief on Tue 18 May or Tue 24 May — please let me know which works for your engineers.

Monica Patel
Customer Success Manager | Redwood Inference
monica.patel@redwood.com
